findings.title: Dimension bound might not cover all vector allocation sites or could over-reject payloads
findings.claim: The report checked whether the dimension bound protects every allocation site (vectorSliceReuse at marshal.go:1015/1026, reflect.MakeSlice at 1083), whether vectorElemMinSize could return 0 causing unsafe division, whether saturation at MaxInt32 is correct, and whether vectorFixedElemSize's type set could overlap with isVectorVariableLengthType's causing the floor to over-reject well-formed payloads; it also checked whether marshalVector needs an equivalent bound.
